name: Message in a Bottle
summary: Along Stranglethorn Vale's shore, Message in a Bottle bears a plea from someone held captive. The writer says a great beast keeps them on an isolated island in the South Seas.

sections.title: A Plea from the Waves
sections.body: A plea for rescue rests in a glass container, half-buried in the sand. The captive is trapped beneath thick jungle canopies on a foreign island, held by a great Skymane. Wild Shore lies to the northwest through the trees. Large sailing vessels drift to the southwest.

sections.title: The Writer of the Note
sections.body: Across the water, the nautical directions point to an offshore isle where Princess Poobah waits. Stranded there, she is desperate for an adventurer to reach her and give her a chance at freedom.

faq.q: What does the note in the bottle say?
aliases: what is written in the bottle
faq.answer: The note is a neatly penned plea for rescue. Its writer says a great Skymane holds them prisoner on an island in the South Seas, and begs whoever finds the note to come to their aid.

faq.q: Where does the writer say the island is located?
faq.answer: The captive says Wild Shore can be seen to the northwest on clear days, while large sailing vessels appear to the southwest. At night, jungle trees hide the stars.

faq.q: What is holding the author captive?
faq.answer: The note says a creature called a great Skymane holds its writer prisoner on the island.

faq.q: Does this lead to further adventures?
faq.answer: Finding the sender begins a two-part chain. The second part follows when you locate the captive.
